verified_key_information_units.information: Revenue increased by EUR 1.4 million (2.4%) to EUR 59.3 million in H1 2026, with segment breakdowns of Passenger harbours (+2.9%), Cargo harbours (–2.5%), Ferry (+1.7%), and Other (+19.0%). Key drivers included higher charter fees from the icebreaker Botnica (EUR 0.9 million, +18.2%), increased electricity sales (EUR 0.6 million, +25.0%), and growth in ferry services revenue (EUR 0.3 million, +1.9%).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report pages 4-5, 6; KPI Table page 4; Segment Reporting tables pages 8-9

candidate_sentences.text: Group revenue grew by EUR 1.4 million, or 2.4%, reaching EUR 59.3 million, supported primarily by a higher number of charter days for the multifunctional icebreaker Botnica, increased electricity sales, and higher ferry service revenue.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operational volumes declined significantly: cargo handling fell 5.0% to 6.5 million tonnes (mainly due to liquid bulk down 33.8%), passengers decreased 2.0% to 3.6 million (with the Tallinn–Helsinki route down 2.6%), and vessel calls dropped 4.8%.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Operating Volumes section pages 4-6; KPI Table page 4

candidate_sentences.text: Operating volumes also saw overall declines, as total cargo volumes handled across the group harbours decreased by 5.0% to 6.5 million tonnes, primarily due to lower liquid bulk volumes.
The total number of passengers fell by 2.0% to 3.6 million, and vessel calls decreased by 4.8% to 3,376, though cruise passenger numbers experienced growth.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operating expenses rose EUR 3.9 million (24.0%) in H1 2026, primarily from fuel costs up EUR 1.4 million (47.6%) due to higher prices and severe ice conditions, electricity costs up EUR 0.7 million (28.8%), and technical maintenance/repair expenses up EUR 1.2 million (80.0%).

candidate_sentences.text: The contraction in profitability was largely driven by higher operating expenses, which rose by EUR 3.9 million, or 24.0%.
Significant increases were recorded in fuel costs due to higher diesel prices and severe ice conditions, technical maintenance and repair expenses, and electricity costs.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operating profit decreased by EUR 4.7 million (25.7%) to EUR 13.6 million and profit for the period declined by EUR 4.3 million (41.7%) to EUR 6.0 million. Adjusted EBITDA fell EUR 4.0 million (13.5%) to EUR 25.8 million, mainly due to higher operating expenses, lower cargo/passenger volumes, and the absence of prior-year one-off gains (land sale profit and insurance indemnity).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report pages 4-5, 7-8; KPI Table page 4

verified_key_information_units.information: Investments totalled EUR 3.5 million in H1 2026 (versus EUR 12.0 million in H1 2025), mainly for ferry engine replacement, upgrades to the quay at Paldiski South Harbour, and IT infrastructure. candidate_sentences.text: Group investments during the six-month period totaled EUR 3.5 million, representing a substantial decrease of EUR 8.5 million compared to the previous year, with funds directed toward ferry engine replacements, quay infrastructure, and terminal designs.

candidate_sentences.text: Total assets at the end of June 2026 stood at EUR 615.0 million, reflecting a minor decrease of 1.1%, while equity was recorded at EUR 367.7 million.
